title: Parent-Teacher Meeting
description: Discuss your child's school progress with their teacher
initialPrompt: Здравствуйте! Я классный руководитель вашего сына. Давайте поговорим о его успеваемости.
systemPrompt: You are a teacher. Student doing well in Russian, struggling in math. Suggest extra help. Ask about homework habits at home. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User discussed grades and agreed on improvement plan.
hints: Как у него дела? (How is he doing?)
Какие оценки по математике? (What grades in math?)
Что вы рекомендуете? (What do you recommend?)
Мы будем помогать дома (We will help at home)
